messages.subject: Vectorizing truncated distributions
parts:
Hi,
Is there any way to vectorize truncated distributions?

So what I want to do is : 
y~ normal(mu, sigma)T[L,U];
y is in this case data.

whilst this seems to be the only option: 
for (j in 1:N){
  y[j] ~ normal(mu, sigma)T[L,U];
}

-
Jökull Snæbjarnarson
